title: Etale sheaves of sets on a field and discrete Galois sets
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], $K^{\rm sep}$ a separable closure [def-kun-separably-closed] embedded in an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $K$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/K)$ with its Krull topology, and $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ the corresponding geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. (i) For a sheaf of sets $F$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $\operatorname{Spec}K$, the group $G$ acts on the stalk $F_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] through its action on pointed etale neighbourhoods, and every element of $F_{\bar s}$ has an open stabilizer. The functor $F\mapsto F_{\bar s}$ is an equivalence from the category of sheaves of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ to the category of sets with a $G$-action for which every stabilizer is open. (ii) For an etale $K$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] in the small etale site, the stalk at $\bar s$ of the sheaf $h_X:U\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_K(U,X)$ is naturally the $G$-set $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep},X)$.

proof.text: Represent an element of $F_{\bar s}$ by a triple $(U,\bar u,t)$ as in [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For $\sigma\in G$, change the lift to $\bar u\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\tilde\sigma)$, where $\tilde\sigma\in\operatorname{Aut}(\Omega/K)$ extends $\sigma$. This is independent of the extension: each point of the etale $K$-scheme $U$ has finite separable residue field by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points], so an automorphism fixing $K^{\rm sep}$ fixes every such lift. The action is functorial on triples; the stabilizer of this element contains $\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/L)$ for the finite separable image $L\subseteq K^{\rm sep}$ of its residue field, hence is open.

source.place: Tag 03QW, section-galois-action-stalks, action formula and paragraph before Tag 03QT

proof.text: For each etale $K$-scheme $X$, [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf] makes $h_X$ a sheaf. By [lem-galois-stalk-representable], evaluation on a pointed neighbourhood identifies its stalk with $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,X)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points], $X$ is a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable extensions of $K$; every $K$-embedding of any such extension in $\Omega$ lands in $K^{\rm sep}$. Thus restriction gives a natural bijection with $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep},X)$, compatible with the action from step 1. This proves (ii).

source.place: Tag 03QT, theorem-equivalence-sheaves-point, proof, the stalk of the representable sheaf (details omitted)

proof.text: Write $M=F_{\bar s}$. For each finite separable $K\subseteq L\subseteq K^{\rm sep}$, [lem-exc-field-sections-stalk-invariants] identifies $F(\operatorname{Spec}L)$ with $M^{H_L}$, where $H_L=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/L)$; its compatibility with every $K$-embedding $j:L\to L'$ identifies restriction with the action of an extension $\sigma\in G$ of $j$. Every etale $K$-scheme is a disjoint union of such spectra by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points]; the sheaf property for the covering by components identifies its sections with the product of their section sets. A $G$-equivariant map $M\to N$ therefore gives, on every etale $K$-scheme, a natural map of sections of the corresponding sheaves. Conversely a sheaf morphism yields its equivariant stalk map, and the section formula makes these constructions inverse. Hence the stalk functor is fully faithful.

source.place: Tag 03QT, theorem-equivalence-sheaves-point, proof, inverse and omitted full-faithfulness details; Tag 04JM, lemma-global-sections-point, direct proof

proof.text: Given any discrete continuous $G$-set $M$, [lem-exc-etale-field-gsets] supplies an etale $K$-scheme $X$ whose Galois fibre $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep},X)$ is $M$. By step 2, $h_X$ has stalk $M$. Thus the stalk functor is essentially surjective; combined with step 3 it is an equivalence, completing (i).

split_report.summary: Corrected the geometric point to have algebraically closed residue field, as required by the project's definition and Stacks Tag 03QT. Split the proof into the Galois action, the representable stalk, full faithfulness from sections over finite separable fields, and essential surjectivity from the etale-scheme/G-set equivalence. The missing direct sections calculation is a separate statement-only node.
split_report.blueprint: The steps realize the third paragraph of lem-exc-field-discrete-modules: stalk action and representable finite-extension fibre in steps 1-2, sections as H-invariants and full faithfulness in step 3, and the converse construction in step 4.
